question: Should the named LiteLLM interactive auth choice collect a base URL and run credentialed model discovery, or should non-local LiteLLM users be directed to the existing Custom Provider or non-interactive `--custom-base-url` path?
rationale: The code gap is clear, but the durable fix changes provider-owned onboarding UX and may add credentialed network discovery during first-run setup, so automation should not pick that policy boundary alone.

options.title: Add LiteLLM interactive setup
options.body: Extend the LiteLLM provider setup to prompt for or confirm the proxy base URL before model selection and then load the provider-scoped catalog from that endpoint.

options.title: Route to Custom Provider
options.body: Keep LiteLLM as localhost/default-model focused and update docs/onboarding copy to direct remote proxy users to Custom Provider or non-interactive setup.

options.title: Defer until provider setup metadata exists
options.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical product/API design item for generic provider base-URL prompt metadata.

recommendation.title: Add LiteLLM interactive setup
recommendation.body: Extend the LiteLLM provider setup to prompt for or confirm the proxy base URL before model selection and then load the provider-scoped catalog from that endpoint.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent commits own the LiteLLM pluginized setup path and the wizard/model-auth flow where the product boundary would be implemented.
